column106: The TEMIT Fixed Rate Note is modelled using a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach. The cashflows (principal and interest payments) are assumed as per the contractual terms and discounted at the yield/discount rate to determine the dirty price of the debt security. The discount rate is determined as the sum of SONIO/N Index rate and Static credit spread of ~1.4% (determined by calibrating the model to the issue price as of the issue date). The dirty price is then adjusted for interest accrual to arrive at a clean price for the TEMIT Fixed Rate Note.
